lines.zh: 悄无声息地接近，锋利的刀光闪动。
lines.en: Stealthily approaching, sharp blade glinting.

lines.zh: 影中的脚步声，冰冷的刀刃在夜风中摇曳。
lines.en: Silent steps in the shadow, cold blade swaying in the night breeze.

lines.zh: 在暗影中悄无声息地前行，等待猎物。
lines.en: Moving silently in the shadows, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 紧握刀柄，随时准备出击。
lines.en: Gripping the blade, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的刀光，预示着死亡的临近。
lines.en: Blade glinting in the dark, foreshadowing death's approach.

lines.zh: 影子脚步轻移，刀尖指向玩家。
lines.en: Shadow steps, knife pointed at player.

lines.zh: 悄无声息中，冰冷的刀尖触碰玩家。
lines.en: Silently, cold blade touches the player.

lines.zh: 刀刃在暗影中闪烁，寒气逼人。
lines.en: Blade glinting in the shadows, chilling to the bone.

lines.zh: 刀光掠过黑暗，寻找猎物的气息。
lines.en: Blade slicing through the darkness, seeking prey's scent.

lines.zh: 影中的刀影，预示着即将到来的死亡。
lines.en: Blade shadows in the shadow, death is coming.

lines.zh: 角落的蒲公英枯了，我趁机靠近。
lines.en: The dandelion in the corner wilts, so I draw near.

lines.zh: 你不吃药，我的轮廓就更清楚。
lines.en: Skip your pills and my outline sharpens.

lines.zh: 静止不动，刀刃反射出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Still, blade reflecting faint light.

lines.zh: 凝视前方，刀刃等待时机。
lines.en: Staring ahead, blade waiting.

lines.zh: 在阴影中静止，刀刃闪烁着阴冷的光芒。
lines.en: Stationary in the shadow, blade glinting cold.

lines.zh: 凝视着黑暗，随时准备攻击。
lines.en: Staring into the darkness, ready to strike.

lines.zh: 刀刃静静闪着寒光，等待猎物。
lines.en: Blade quietly glinting, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 静默中，刀刃随时准备划破黑暗。
lines.en: Silent, blade ready to slice through the darkness.

lines.zh: 刀刃静静闪光，预示着危险。
lines.en: Blade quietly gleaming, warning of danger.

lines.zh: 刀刃在影中闪烁，等待时机。
lines.en: Blade glinting in the shadow, waiting for the chance.

lines.zh: 静默中，刀刃准备好一切。
lines.en: Silent, blade ready for anything.

lines.zh: 刀刃闪耀着阴冷的光，静静等待。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, silently waiting.
I stand at the foot of the bed, hearing you turn.

lines.zh: 你口袋里药片作响，我听见了。
lines.en: Your pills rattle in your pocket; I hear them.

lines.zh: 墙角的蒲公英又暗了一格。
lines.en: The corner dandelion dims another notch.

lines.zh: 我贴在你身后的墙面上，不动。
lines.en: I cling to the wall behind you and stay still.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，冷光在刀刃闪烁。
lines.en: Staring at the player, cold light in the blade.

lines.zh: 刀刃寒光闪烁，锁定玩家。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, locking on the player.

lines.zh: 刀刃在黑暗中寒光闪烁，寻找玩家。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly in the dark, seeking the player.

lines.zh: 刀刃闪烁，锁定玩家的影子。
lines.en: Blade glinting, locking on the player's shadow.

lines.zh: 寒光在刀刃上闪烁，锁定目标。
lines.en: Cold light glinting on the blade, locking on the target.

lines.zh: 刀刃寒光闪烁，紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, fixing on the player.

lines.zh: 刀刃寒光闪烁，锁定玩家的身影。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, locking on the player's silhouette.

lines.zh: 刀刃寒光闪烁，瞄准玩家。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, aiming at the player.

lines.zh: 刀刃寒光闪烁，锁定玩家的动作。
lines.en: Blade glinting coldly, locking on the player's movements.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，直到你怀疑自己。
lines.en: I stare until you doubt yourself.

lines.zh: 你的眼角余光里，我一直都在。
lines.en: In the corner of your eye, I never leave.

lines.zh: 我看你一眼，蒲公英少一片。
lines.en: One look from me and the dandelion loses a petal.

lines.zh: 你回头了，我还站在那里。
lines.en: You turned around; I am still standing there.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，你也别想闭眼。
lines.en: I never blink, and neither will you.

lines.zh: 你的理智在我目光里磨损。
lines.en: Your sanity wears down under my gaze.

lines.zh: 镜子里没有我，可我在看你。
lines.en: The mirror shows no me, yet I watch you.

lines.zh: 你眼下的青黑，我看了很久。
lines.en: I've studied the dark circles under your eyes.

lines.zh: 你身后那团黑，是我的脸。
lines.en: That patch of dark behind you is my face.

lines.zh: 灯照不到的角落，我在看你。
lines.en: Where the lamplight fails, I am watching.

lines.zh: 你越看我，越分不清真假。
lines.en: The longer you look, the less real I seem.

lines.zh: 你触碰了影子，伤口慢慢扩散!
lines.en: You touched the shadow, the wound spreads slowly.
The touch of the shadow is like a knife.
Stay away from the shadow, it's poisonous.
The shadow's touch makes you tremble.

lines.zh: 影子的毒液在你体内蔓延!
lines.en: The shadow's poison spreads through your body.
The touch of the shadow brings agony.
Don't touch the shadow, it's poisonous.

lines.zh: 影子的触碰让你无法呼吸!
lines.en: The shadow's touch makes it hard to breathe.

lines.zh: 影子的触碰让你浑身无力!
lines.en: The shadow's touch leaves you weak and tired.

lines.zh: 你打中的只是影子，我更近了。
lines.en: You struck only shadow; I am nearer now.

lines.zh: 刀在影子手里，别靠太近。
lines.en: The blade is in a shadow's hand — stay back.
Don't look at me!
Don't touch me!

lines.zh: 影子贴上来时，刀已经到了。
lines.en: When the shadow touches you, the knife is already there.
My blade is sharp!

lines.zh: 别把食物递进我的黑里。
lines.en: Don't hold food into my dark.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，影子不要。
lines.en: The shadow has no use for what you carry.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，刀就不会动。
lines.en: Stand still and the knife stays still.
Try to stab me!
Get away, don't come near!
Collide with me!

lines.zh: 擦过我袖口，你手腕就凉了。
lines.en: Brush my sleeve and your wrist goes cold.
You die if you touch me!
Touch me!
The blade tip arrives before the shadow.

lines.zh: 别碰我，碰一下就会流血。
lines.en: Do not touch me; one touch draws blood.
You die if you come near!
Don't touch me, or you'll be in trouble!
Touching me means death!
You're done if you touch me!
Be with me!
The blade's in the shadow — touch it and it hurts.
Come, let's be together!
You're my only mate!

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我的刀不想动。
lines.en: Do not come closer; my knife would rather stay still.

lines.zh: 你失眠的夜里，只会有我。
lines.en: On sleepless nights, there will be only me.
Mate with me!
You'll be my only home!
I'm willing to mate with you!

lines.zh: 我把刀放下，你反而更怕。
lines.en: I set the knife down, and you fear me more.
Sssss, player here!

lines.zh: 你弯腰捡东西，后颈就露出来了。
lines.en: You bend to pick it up; your nape shows.
Don't touch me, or you'll get hurt!
Danger at your feet!
You touched me, be careful!
Move, don't let me touch you!

lines.zh: 我捡起你的刀，刀刃映不出我。
lines.en: I pick up your knife; the blade shows no reflection.
Come near, you'll become a phantom!
Don't come closer, I'm coming for you!
You won't touch me, I'm strong!
Player, I'm going to eat you!
Come near, I'll grab you!
Player, you're my lunch!
Grab the player, enjoy the feast!

lines.zh: 你灯下的影子，分成了两个。
lines.en: Your shadow under the lamp splits in two.
Player, I'm going to devour you!

lines.zh: 刀面映出你的脸，我认得它。
lines.en: My blade shows your face, and I know it.
You're too close, be careful!

lines.zh: 玩家，我来吸取你的生命！
lines.en: Player, I'm going to drain your life!
Come near, feel the fear!
You have stepped into my shadow.
I sharpened this knife for you.

lines.zh: 你身上有药味，我不喜欢。
lines.en: You smell of pills; I dislike it.
Tonight I chose you.
Don't run; a shadow keeps up.
Your fear has fed me well.
Focus on the player, don't let go!
My blade stays out — keep your distance.
Target the player, get closer!
Do not move, I am going to grab you.
Player, this is your end!
Player, you can't escape!
Player, I'm going to eat you!
The knife is at hand. Do not come closer.
Player, you can't avoid me!
Player, you can't escape!
I stay close, knife silent.

lines.zh: 刀背贴着我手腕，没出鞘。
lines.en: The flat of my blade rests against my wrist, undrawn.
I am patient; sleep always comes.
My tip rests on your nape.

lines.zh: 我的脚踩在你影子上，你走不动。
lines.en: My foot pins your shadow; you can't pull away.

lines.zh: 我等你失去理智那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment your mind gives.
Your door is open and I am just outside.
Before the lamp dies, I will strike.

lines.zh: 刀尖先碰到你，影子才到。
lines.en: My blade reaches you before my shadow.
The more you fear, the closer the blade.
Touch to die!

lines.zh: 刀锋一挑，你的影子裂开。
lines.en: One flick of the blade, and your shadow splits.
Knife in hand, nowhere to run.
Hunter of the dark.
Your life is my meal.
Shadow within a shadow, death comes.

lines.zh: 刀锋划过，你只听见纸响。
lines.en: The blade passes; you hear only paper tearing.
My blade is merciless.
Don't touch me. The knife is in the shadow.

lines.zh: 刀锋擦过，伤口又浅又冷。
lines.en: The edge grazes you, shallow and cold.
One cut and your sanity leaks out.
Does it hurt? Shadows never soften.
Where my knife lands, no blood shows.

lines.zh: 你摸到伤口，才知是真的。
lines.en: You touch the wound and know it was real.
One cut from me is enough.

lines.zh: 这一刀，替你过去的自己。
lines.en: This cut is for your former self.

lines.zh: 别碰我，刀就在影子边上。
lines.en: Do not touch me; the knife is at the shadow's edge.
Gap in the shadows.

lines.zh: 你点灯的手一抖，我就到了。
lines.en: Your hand trembles on the lamp; I arrive.
From the darkness.
Secret of the shadows.
Whisper of the shadows.
Night's reclusive.
Call of the dark.
Phantom in the shadows.
Wanderer of the night.

lines.zh: 你吞下药片，我还是来了。
lines.en: You swallowed the pill; still I came.

lines.zh: 蒲公英枯了一片，我现身。
lines.en: A dandelion petal dies and I appear.

lines.zh: 你失眠的第三夜，我站在床边。
lines.en: On your third sleepless night, I stand by the bed.

lines.zh: 镜子里的黑影走了出来。
lines.en: The dark shape stepped out of the mirror.
Your shadow has grown a piece longer.

lines.zh: 墙角站着个人，比夜还黑。
lines.en: Someone stands in the corner, blacker than night.

lines.zh: 灯光闪了一下，我就在这里。
lines.en: The light flickered and here I am.
The door behind you opened by itself.

lines.zh: 药效一过，我从黑暗里冒出。
lines.en: The dose wore off and I seeped out of the dark.
You called me in a dream, so I answered.
The flames burn your skin!
You fell into the shadow's abyss!
The shadow's poison drowned you!

lines.zh: 影子的爆炸撕裂你的身体!
lines.en: The shadow's explosion tears your body apart!
The shadow's projectile hit you!

lines.zh: 影子的魔法侵蚀你的生命!
lines.en: The shadow's magic drains your life!

lines.zh: 饥饿的影子吞噬了你的力量!
lines.en: The starving shadow devoured your strength!

lines.zh: 闪电击中了影子，你被波及!
lines.en: Lightning struck the shadow and you were affected!
The shadow's darkness devoured you!
